# FIA Labs

> We don’t just predict outcomes. We reason them.

FIA Labs is a DBA of Federated Intel AI LLC, a privately owned company in Washington, D.C., wholly owned by Unison Pictures Pty Ltd. It builds expert AI systems for high-consequence professional work.

This is the parent lab site. Products live on their own domains. FIA Labs does not sell Lite editions, custom GPTs, affiliate products, or a $49 catalog.

## Public products

- [Legal Intel (LIA Pro)](https://legalintel.ai): governed legal and forensic reasoning. Desk: https://pro.legalintel.ai
- [Aquinian Studio](https://aquinian.com): a virtual Thomistic intellect for theology, philosophy, doctrine, natural law, and cultural analysis. Studio: https://studio.aquinian.com
- [Medical Intel (MIA Pro)](https://medicalintel.org): medical AI research for literature, biotechnology, and the medico-legal file. Not medical advice. Desk: https://mia.medicalintel.org
- [Brandium Pro](https://brandium.pro): positioning, creative strategy, and acquisition under unit economics
- [CFO Sentinel](https://cfosentinel.pro): cash, margins, runway, and downside
- [Cine-Novelist](https://cinenovelist.com): character, structure, theme, and scene — stories that can withstand revision

Human judgment remains the authority. These are not substitutes for counsel, a physician, a priest, a CFO, or other licensed professionals.

## Forthcoming — named, not offered

ExecMind (executive decisions), CarCounsel (automotive guidance).

They belong to the federation. They are not public, not for sale, and not offered as chatbots. A desk ships when it can show working.

## Method

Eight specialist systems. Two engines: a generation engine proposes; a symbolic engine tests. Symbolic arbitration, sequential reasoning, and a visible distinction between evidence, inference, and gap. A conclusion that cannot be reconstructed is not ready for this kind of work.

The patented federated system — eight specialists reasoning together under arbitration — is under development.
